slides.title:
The wrong
room
slides.subtitle: When a graha sits in its weakest sign

slides.label: What it means
slides.title: Neecha
body: Each graha has one weakest sign

slides.label: The fall can be undone
slides.title: Neecha bhanga
body: One rule: the owner of that sign sits
slides.closing: The weak spot becomes a hard-won skill

slides.label: In the sky now
slides.title: Two in the wrong room
body: The king (Sun) in Libra, until Monday
The lover (Venus) in Virgo, until the 22nd
Easy on pride and on spending

slides.label: Sutra
slides.quote:
A skill learned
the long way
is still a skill

slides.label: Practical remedy
slides.title: Practice the weak spot
body:
Find any graha in its weakest sign
in your chart
Practice it on purpose, ten minutes a day
slides.closing: Ask about your weakest graha at asksutram.com
